git checkout -q -b perfproof/rolling && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='rolling.py'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index("    out = np.empty(n - width + 1")
s=s[:i]+'''    prefix = np.cumsum(values, dtype=np.int64)
    out = np.empty(n - width + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    out[0] = prefix[width - 1]
    np.subtract(prefix[width:], prefix[:-width], out=out[1:])
    return out
'''
s=s.replace("Runs in O(n) time with a running total.","Runs in O(n) time with a prefix sum; int64 wraparound cancels in\n    the differences, so the result is exact whenever each window sum fits.")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 -m pytest -q -m "not deliberately_flaky" tests 2>&1 | tail -3; git add rolling.py && git commit -qm "rolling_sum: use a numpy prefix sum instead of a Python loop
